stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Psychiatric nursing and de-escalation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：治療性溝通與暴力預防
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Therapeutic communication and violence prevention
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「治療性溝通與暴力預防」在精神科護理與去激化中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' within Psychiatric nursing and de-escalation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「治療性溝通與暴力預防」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「治療性溝通與暴力預防」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention'.
steps.failure: 若「治療性溝通與暴力預防」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「治療性溝通與暴力預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「治療性溝通與暴力預防」是精神科護理與去激化的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' is a core component of Psychiatric nursing and de-escalation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：治療性溝通與暴力預防」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Therapeutic communication and violence prevention'?
options: 已正確完成「治療性溝通與暴力預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 已正確完成「治療性溝通與暴力預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: 'Therapeutic communication and violence prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.
